propositions: A code-verifiable AC (repo path/symbol evidence exists) carrying [operator-attested] tag was incorrectly accepted at close because the completion verifier trusts tags by design (ADR-0043) and no deterministic pre-close guard rejected the laundered classification.
Evidence-kind routing criterion fired but returned no finding on the tagged AC citing exact repo paths, indicating a nondeterministic LLM judgment miss with no blocking backstop.
Provenance continuation line gaps were detected by det_measurement_provenance (P6 finding) but stayed advisory per contract, allowing the verdict to remain PASS.

A new deterministic close-path guard (det_attestation_launder.py + ensure_attested_items_valid precheck) now blocks ACs with repo path/symbol citations under [operator-attested] unless provenance line is present, failing before any LLM runs.

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo-verifiable + external outcome) are now disambiguated via a per-line evidence-vs-orientation rule: test-shaped citations always fire; other repo citations fire only with evidence-introducing words; commit/Gerrit numbers never fire (ADR-0043 compliance).
